assertions.name: external HTTPS fixture receives no portal access header
external HTTPS fixture receives no portal refresh header

limits: Actual portal DOM, shared Axios interceptors, React reducers, Timeout controller, and public consumer interfaces execute.
Synthetic access/refresh credentials and identity responses test client control flow. Initial login uses isolated local BFF.
No live account switch, business application records, external HTTPS server, production, or cryptographic browser authorization is established.
Playwright intercepts the external HTTPS request before transport. No third-party host or credential was contacted.
